# A round with the default base_reds_file and a sync line reaches its sync gate. The record of the base reds is written first. The gate then
# judges the folder of the round at the head of the sync line, and its clean-tree check passes: the record is not in that folder.
isolate

exec git init -q -b main origin
exec git -C origin add readme.txt
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m start
exec git -C origin checkout -q -b integration/r1
exec git -C origin add BASE_MARKER .gitignore
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m base
exec git -C origin checkout -q main

example local/project.star config/projects/local.star
replace config/projects/local.star '~/work/your-repo' $WORK/origin
# The script tests the round, not the sandbox, so its project keeps the sandbox off as it did before the example set it.
replace config/projects/local.star 'sandbox = "on"' 'sandbox = "off"'
replace config/projects/local.star '"make check"' '"sh '$WORK'/gate.sh"'
replace config/projects/local.star 'test_report = "reports/*.xml",' 'test_report = "reports/*.xml", vars = {"round": {"base": "integration/r1", "owner": "owner", "lane_cap": 1, "fix_rounds": 1, "label": "round","base_reds": ["TestKnownRed"]}},'
subst gate.sh
example remediation/workflow.star flow/example.star
replace flow/example.star 'def main(item):' 'def round_main(item):'
replace flow/example.star '    review = agent(' '    review = stub_review('
exec cat flow/example.star flow/driver.star
cp stdout flow/round.star
subst flow/round.star

exec beehavereal item add local round/integration/r1 --title 'The round' --body-file body.txt
exec beehavereal run round/integration/r1 local --workflow flow/round.star
stdout 'item round/integration/r1 finished'
grep '^sync-review$' sync.result

# The record sits outside the folder of the round, so the folder holds no change that is not committed.
exists state/trees/local/base-reds-integration_2Fr1.md
! exists state/trees/local/round_2Fintegration_2Fr1/base-reds-integration_2Fr1.md
grep 'TestKnownRed' state/trees/local/base-reds-integration_2Fr1.md

-- body.txt --
The round of the base.
-- origin/readme.txt --
The source repository.
-- origin/BASE_MARKER --
base marker
-- origin/.gitignore --
reports/
-- gate.sh --
mkdir -p reports
echo '<testsuite name="g" tests="1"><testcase classname="g" name="t"/></testsuite>' > reports/g.xml
-- flow/driver.star --

# The test ends the pass at the review, which comes after the gate. A review that rejects ends it with the reason sync-review.
def stub_review(**ignored):
    return struct(stop = "", verdict = "reject")

def main(item):
    project = facts()
    round_settings = settings(project)
    record_base_reds(round_settings)
    head = command(name = "sync-head", run = ["git", "rev-parse", "origin/integration/r1"]).stdout.strip()
    ended = sync_land(item, project, round_settings, {"branch": "integration/r1", "head": head, "pr": "7"}, 1)
    command(name = "sync-result", run = ["sh", "-c", "echo " + ended.reason + " > @WORK@/sync.result"])
